title: Total cohomology of one smart vertical layer
statement: Let C be abelian, with diagonal totals of nonnegative double complexes. For such a K and p,q≥0, H^(p+q)(Tot(W[q,q+1)(K))) is isomorphic to H^p of the horizontal complex obtained by applying vertical H^q to every column. Here W is [def-sp-double-complex-vertical-window].

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 2, first sequence; spectral-object reformulation

proof.text: Truncation from below at q replaces the degree-q term by its opcycles. Truncation from above at q then takes the kernel of the outgoing map, giving H^q of that column; all other terms vanish. The canonical homology comparisons are natural in column maps.

The total diagonal in degree p+q has only the (p,q) summand. The vertical differential vanishes and the horizontal map has sign +1. Naturality identifies it with H^q of the horizontal map. Thus the three-term homology complexes identify. When p=0 both predecessor terms vanish; when q=0 extension by zero gives the same cycles and boundaries. Apply the short-complex homology functor to this isomorphism.
